title: An overview of Luigi, Prefect and Dagster

videos.script: One job: load raw, build the models, write a report. Three tools that are not Airflow. {{job}} Luigi asks one question of every task. Does its output exist? {{luigi}} Run it twice, and the second time it does nothing. {{again}} When a step fails, it resumes from that step, and no one has to say where. {{resume}} Prefect is plain Python. A flow calls its tasks, in order. {{prefect}} Run it twice, and it does everything twice. {{twice}} Dagster describes the data, not the steps. It remembers when each thing was made. {{dagster}} And none of them knew that the shop had changed a day after it was loaded.
